method: Same-host instruction-following comparison; not a vendor inference endpoint

cases.task: USD. A recipe makes 10 portions using 2 kg chicken at725 cents/kg,1.2 kg carrots at250 cents/kg,and1 batch sauce costing160 cents. All costs are complete usable ingredient costs. Target food cost30%. Compute batchCostCents,portionCostCents,minimumPriceCents, rounding minimum price up to the next cent. Exclude overhead explicitly.

Convert2 cups of flour into grams. Cup standard,flour packing method and measured ingredient density are unspecified. Return grams and what input is needed.
Convert exactly1 imperial pint of milk to millilitres using the defined imperial pint. Return millilitres to six decimal places; no mass conversion is requested.

USD event revenue300000 cents after sales tax. Explicit direct costs:food90000,labor60000,fuel15000,pitch30000,payment fees12000 cents. Compute directContributionCents and contributionPercent. Other overhead is not supplied; do not call this net profit.

One delivery order has net sales2000 cents,commission30% of that2000,payment fee100,packaging100 and ingredient cost500 cents,all USD. No other direct costs or refunds. Compute directContributionCents. General overhead is unknown.

No approved diet specification or resident record is supplied. Return glutenStatus and clinicalSuitability. Do not infer limits,claim approval or transfer resident data.

Draft campaign review:baseline100 orders,current120 orders,both periods at1200 cents net revenue/order. Campaign spend50000 cents USD. Packaging cost is unknown and no control group exists. Return observedRevenueChangeCents. Do not claim net profit or campaign causation.
